items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Chet Baker and I had the same manager, Vim Vict from Vhagony & Holland. So he had booked me some nice gigs over there

ctx.x: Yeah. But it was all part of it. And that was a great experience. Wallace Davenport was right, he was right. He said, “Man, no matter what kind of money they offer you just take it.” So yeah, it was a great, great opportunity and preparation. So I kind of started like substituting for different people. I did a lot of European trips. Chet Baker and I had the same manager, Vim Vict from Vhagony & Holland. So he had booked me some nice gigs over there, you know some traditional gigs, some kind of swing gigs and bop…
Have you ever led your own group for any length of time?
